top3_by_cost_of_inaction.cost: Every deploy during an export silently loses the job and can mislabel a valid session as interrupted; no retry exists, so the operator's download truth decays without a signal.
The P0 gate cannot be signed off. With files as the unit the matrix overstates downloaded by 29 for the only real account, so the answer to 'what is missing' changes with the implementation.
A full P1 item rebuilds shipped cross-account search and risks regressing the catalog while touching the same data as P1-4.
